All thanks to it UltraPro Technology that combines the power of science & nature! With UltraPro Technology, Vim floor Cleaner penetrates deep into stains & dirt and dissolves them from within effectively. This ensures removal of tough stains! Whether it's dried sticky stain of spilt over food like sambhar, chutney, dal or sticky drink stain of coffee, tea or cold drink – Vim Ultrapro Floor cleaner effectively removes all of them!
Tired of dealing with messy, dirty floors that are hard to clean? Vim UltraPro Floor Cleaner is here to help! With advanced UltraPro Technology, it ensures removal of tough stains and dirt, while also removing germs. Enjoy an exotic spa-like fragrance that lasts up to 4 hours with every clean!
Simultaneously, fragrance which has been infused in the Vim floor cleaner liquid bursts out & spreads spa like fragrance across your house! 
Vim UltraPro Floor Cleaner is available in three exotic fragrance variants—Sparkling Lemon, French Lavender with Sage, and Refreshing Lemongrass with Salt.
Not just fragrances, Vim UltraPro Floor cleaner comes in a variety of Pack Sizes: Choose from various pack sizes—1L Bottle, 500ml Bottle, and 1.8L Pouch—to suit your needs.
Experience a superior clean with Vim UltraPro Floor Cleaner and keep your floors spotless clean & smelling fresh for long!

Introducing the new Vim UltraPro Floor Cleaner from India’s No.1 dishwashing brand, Vim. Thanks to its advanced UltraPro Technology, which combines the power of science and nature, this floor cleaner penetrates deep into stains and dirt, dissolving them effectively to ensure 100% removal of even the toughest marks. Whether it’s dried, sticky food spills such as sambar, chutney, or dal, or stubborn drink stains from coffee, tea, or cold beverages, Vim UltraPro Floor Cleaner tackles them all with ease.
Struggling with messy, hard-to-clean floors is now a thing of the past. Vim UltraPro Floor Cleaner not only removes tough stains and dirt but also eliminates germs, leaving your floors hygienic and spotless. Its exotic spa-like fragrance lasts up to four hours, releasing a refreshing aroma that spreads throughout your home with every clean.
Vim UltraPro Floor Cleaner is available in three delightful fragrance variants – Sparkling Lemon, French Lavender with Sage, and Refreshing Lemongrass with Salt. It also comes in a range of convenient pack sizes, including a 500 ml bottle, a 1 L bottle, and a 1.8 L pouch, to suit your household needs. Experience superior cleaning with Vim UltraPro Floor Cleaner and enjoy floors that are impeccably clean and wonderfully fresh-smelling.
